task: Add a user notification preferences page with backend persistence and a toggle UI.
output:
Task real-006 (user notification preferences page) — COMPLETE, all criteria verified.

## What was built
- `src/server.js` (modified): `NotificationService` wired into `createServer`; new routes — `GET /users/:userId/notification-preferences` (JSON), `PUT /users/:userId/notification-preferences` (JSON partial-update with validation → 400 on non-boolean emailEnabled/pushEnabled or digest outside daily/weekly/off), `GET /users/:userId/preferences` (HTML page).
- `src/preferences-page.js` (new): dependency-free HTML page — email/push toggles (`role="switch"`), digest `<select>` (daily/weekly/off), server-side rendered current state (`checked`/`selected` + `window.__PREFS__`), status bar (`role="status"`, aria-live). Page JS: `change` on any control → `PUT` → on success updates status bar ("Saved — email off, push on, digest weekly"), on failure reverts control to last saved state.
- `test/preferences.test.js` (new): 7 tests — GET defaults, PUT persists + GET reflects, persistence across a brand-new server instance on the same store dir, 400 validation, page served as HTML with toggle markup, page reflects saved state after a toggle round-trip, page JS wiring (fetch PUT / change listener / status role).
- `README.md` (modified): one layout line for the new module.

## Criteria verification (all backed by runs)
1. **preferences persist** — automated restart test passes; live E2E: killed and restarted the server process on the same temp store, `GET /users/alice/notification-preferences` still returned `{"userId":"alice","emailEnabled":false,"pushEnabled":true,"digest":"weekly"}`, and the page reload rendered those states.
2. **toggle updates UI** — real browser at http://127.0.0.1:38913/users/alice/preferences: clicking the Push toggle checked the box and the status bar updated to "Saved — email on, push on, digest daily"; toggling email off + digest weekly → "Saved — email off, push on, digest weekly"; reload showed persisted state.
